purpose: Bounded PostgreSQL name-role repair and explicit race instrumentation for nested generated-package tests

new_structural_controls.native_observation: The first27 sources passed on PostgreSQL18.7 in46036218162; the exact appended unqualified operator(name) source was a syntax error. Its SQL/direct allow=false remains unchanged; native_error now records42601 and the corrected proof will require the explicit server code. No source was applied in that failed run.

scope.token_advance: Each lexical branch advances through a complete name, opaque literal, comment or punctuation; no literal contents become identifier candidates.
scope.name_roles: Complete identifier chains exclude qualifier components, call/type heads, explicit aliases/collations, recognized write headers and terminal bare RETURNING aliases; expression operands and call arguments remain visible.
scope.case: ASCII folding for unquoted names; quoted names preserve case and unescape doubled quotes.
scope.limitation: Syntactic presence check, not complete reference-to-table binding across nested queries or CTE scopes.
scope.nested_race: Only -race is added to the existing shared generated-package test command.
scope.operator_shape: The OPERATOR construct must start at an unqualified keyword and contain an optional qualified-name prefix followed only by symbolic operator characters from PostgreSQL REL_18_4 scan.l. The qualified function named operator remains an ordinary operand; the unqualified operator(name) spelling is an explicit native/upstream syntax-rejection control.

required_gates: Authenticated unchanged-source and missing-race baseline; preserve both observer failures
Native27 valid SQL states and one syntax rejection, actual27 captured requests plus one upstream absence, with unchanged-production17RED/11controls before application
Actual nested argv includes-race in both generated module directories
Native compiler/race focused tests and actual just gate/slop/eject

findings.problem: Quoted identifier text was used as structural punctuation.
findings.correction: All delimiter, depth, cast and name-head checks now require referencePunctuation through the private punctuation method.

findings.problem: The closing parenthesis of a qualified OPERATOR name was treated as the end of an expression that could take a bare alias.
findings.correction: Bare-alias classification now distinguishes OPERATOR's matching parentheses by token kind and depth.

findings.problem: The final name component operator before '(' was treated as the OPERATOR construct even for a normal function.
findings.correction: Require unqualified construct spelling plus an actual symbolic operator name inside the matching parentheses.

observer_failure.reason: Incorrect native-valid prediction for unquoted unqualified operator(name)
observer_failure.corrected_fields: Only that row's impossible native_name/native_version expectations become native_error=42601; SQL and direct allow=false stay exact.
